definitions.signal: First eligible minute-close reconstruction of partial 15m strategy, not historical tick or Telegram receipt.
definitions.one_minute: 20 regular-session minute closes, deviation 2/ddof 0, at this minute close. Exact consecutive official trading minutes required.
definitions.fifteen_reference: 20 known completed 15m closes plus known actual current candle opening; final closing minute required for every reference candle.
definitions.outcome: Underlying close return from observed signal price, and separately from first full minute open after availability. Comparisons use signal-price direction. Not option profit, no costs or fills.
definitions.original_candle: Postsignal divergence restricted to remaining minutes of original 15m candle; censored when it ends.
definitions.independence: Matched complete 15-minute futures, no overlap within company/source; all alignment signals also reported separately.
definitions.chronology: Older training interval, next 30 days validation, latest 30 days descriptive recent. Already explored history is not prospective validation.

hypotheses_fixed_before_run: 15m exposure can coexist with inside/opposite 1m bands.
Compare 1m same-direction outside versus inside at signal; no automatic live filter.
Measure 1m reentry/divergence while original 15m exposure persists.
limitations: Stored minute OHLC cannot establish first qualifying tick, intraminute order, exact exposure duration or phone receipt.
IEX-only and missing-minute complete-case selection can bias results, particularly thin symbols.
Groups are observational; day-cluster intervals and within-feature comparisons are exploratory, not causal or calibrated probabilities.
No optimization or live alert/order/UI changes.

observed_reentries_1m.definition: First same-direction-outside to inside 1m close transition while original 15m remains outside. Price change measured between these consecutive closes, not intraminute order. Known only when transition occurs.
